metadata.title: Instacart Is Pursuing a Sale, Report Says. Here’s What Makes It Enticing.<!-- --> - Barron's

content.text:
Instacart Is Pursuing a Sale, Report Says. Here’s What Makes It Enticing.
A report that the delivery app Instacart is pursuing a sale sent shares up 9% on Friday shortly before the market closed. Instacart declined to comment, but it’s easy to see why the shopping service is a good takeover candidate.
